items.title: Australia announces potential new oil refinery for the country, first since the 1960s
items.summary: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has announced a joint plan with West Australia's government to fund a new study into large-scale oil refinery. The refinery is aimed at protecting the country's economy from further global energy shocks. If the refinery goes ahead, it would be the first new large-scale petrol refinery built in Australia since the 1960s. This comes as the cut in fuel excise is due to expire by the end of the week

items.title: Ben Carroll replaces Jacinta Allan in Victorian Labor spill
items.summary: Ben Carroll has been sworn in as Victorian Premier, replacing Jacinta Allan after she lost support from the Labor caucus. He was challenged by Attorney General Sonya Kilkenny in a tense and chaotic caucus meeting on Tuesday morning, before ultimately being elected unopposed. Transport Minister Gabrielle Williams will serve as his deputy ahead of the state election in November.
